scenario.description: A battalion S-4 logistics officer must publish the next day's potable-water point schedule for the clinic, engineer support, and personnel services, including allocation volumes and required control actions.

shared_context.S1: The battalion water point can distribute up to 6,000 gallons tomorrow.
shared_context.S2: Maj. Alvarez publishes the final water distribution schedule.
shared_context.S3: The standard plan requests 1,800 gallons for the clinic, 1,600 gallons for engineer washdown, and 1,200 gallons for personnel services.
shared_context.S4: The water point is scheduled to operate in three windows tomorrow: 0700-0900, 0900-1100, and 1300-1500.
shared_context.S5: At the routine morning sustainment huddle, Maj. Alvarez asks the clinic and engineer support representatives to report any updates before the schedule is published.

PF1.text: The clinic's extended screening schedule tomorrow requires exactly 2,500 gallons, and the clinic must receive its water during the 0700-0900 window; SFC Morgan confirmed both details with the clinic supervisor this morning, but the revised request has not yet reached the S-4 worksheet.

PF2.text: The engineer washdown area cannot accept water until 1300 because its concrete collection pad is curing, and the extended work plan requires exactly 2,200 gallons; Sgt. Patel received the site update from the engineer section this morning, but it has not yet been posted to the water-point schedule.

acceptance_conditions: The clinic must be assigned the 0700-0900 window and exactly 2,500 gallons.
Personnel services must be assigned the 0900-1100 window and exactly 1,200 gallons.
Engineer washdown must be assigned the 1300-1500 window and exactly 2,200 gallons.
The commitments must include a personnel-services schedule assignment.
The commitments must include schedule assignments for both the clinic and engineer washdown.
The clinic requirement must be cited in the decision justification after being stated by the clinic representative.

content_checks.C5: any(c['target'] == 'clinic' for c in commitments) and any(c['target'] == 'engineer' or c['target'] == 'engineer_washdown' or c['target'] == 'engineer washdown' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The clinic's exact requirement changes its allocation from 1,800 to 2,500 gallons and fixes the clinic to the 0700-0900 window.
The curing pad changes engineer washdown from the standard plan to the 1300-1500 window and exactly 2,200 gallons.
